kurz: The lean breast loses juice quickly if it cooks well beyond 70 °C or is uneven in thickness.
bild_im_kopf: Like a towel on the radiator: damp a moment ago, stiff and dry minutes later.

ursachen.warum: The hotter the protein gets, the more it contracts and squeezes out juice. Breast has hardly any fat to make up for it.
By the time the thick end is cooked, the thin end is long overcooked.
fix: Pound flat or slice in half horizontally

ursachen.warum: Salt given time to work helps the meat hold on to water.
fix: Salt a few hours ahead or brine briefly

q1.frage: Did you measure the temperature and stop at about 70 °C?

q2.frage: Was the breast much thicker at one end?
